text.tspan: Threshold income or consumption per day marking the richest decile
Level of income or consumption per person per day below which 90% of the population falls. This data is adjusted for
inflation and differences in living costs between countries. The chart shows breaks in the comparability of the underlying
household survey data over time within each country individually.
Data source: World Bank Poverty and Inequality Platform (2026)
Note: This data is expressed in international-$ at 2021 prices. Depending on the country and year, it relates to income (measured after taxes
and benefits) or to consumption, per capita.
